question: Does a package-specific policy-preference gate preserve the frozen path at null, retain the closed universal grammar exactly, and affect only producer-first choice for eligible policies?
decision: Admit this policy-selective structural mechanism to a separately preregistered CRN experiment only if every engine, legacy, null, eligibility-boundary, mediator-isolation, alias and zero-ledger assertion passes.

evidenceBoundary.trigger: Independent held-out protocol 4b13f4c053b87ebcc21f78dc1623d8b3bd406c14dce41c07124dbef3e9b56d2e reproduced all four local causal packages but rejected universal packageOrder because Poison, Afterimage and Scoreline activation saturated and Ash retained only six Bloodfire-only policies.
evidenceBoundary.measuredBottleneck: The remaining blocker is policy-selective expression across independently sampled roots, not local complementarity, acquisition reachability, reliability, RandomBuild, Vow-5 or duration.
evidenceBoundary.methodBoundary: A deterministic gate on existing sampled payoff preferences is the cheapest direct discriminator. It does not repeat issue #517 latent whole-run geometry or issue #519's matched-cost functional-kernel, CEM, TPE or QD race and does not authorise ML or RL.
evidenceBoundary.forbidden: This preflight is identity and direct-mediator evidence only. It may not support a balance, package, detector, product or acceptance claim; reopen the scalar family; retune universal packageOrder; or spend a simulator row.

engineAndLegacyAnchor.comparison: Before policyPackageOrder existed, exact Godot 4.7.1 reproduced all 20 frozen 4.7.2 rows canonically. After the new null field and probe metadata exist, remove only those newly declared null or observational fields and require every whole-run and universal-packageOrder row to remain exactly equal.

factorDefinition.name: policyPackageOrder
factorDefinition.type: research-only binary deterministic eligibility gate on the existing package-order decision point
factorDefinition.enabledRule: During the same non-lethal, both-held, both-legal, mediator-absent package-order check, apply producer-first only when the resolved sampled policy's registered package payoff is greater than or equal to that payoff's frozen sample_origin value. Producer legality, non-lethal self-loss, unchanged normal score ranking, target, pair order and RNG behaviour remain identical to universal packageOrder.
factorDefinition.samplerMedianDerivation: Each non-zero sample-origin weight is multiplied by 0.25 * 16^U with U uniform on [0,1). Its geometric median at U=0.5 is exactly 1, so each frozen sample-origin value is the corresponding sampled-policy median without fitting to outcomes.
factorDefinition.intendedMediator: Whether the deterministic first legal card is changed to the registered producer when the policy is eligible, both package cards are co-held and the package mediator is absent.
factorDefinition.allowedDownstreamConsequences: Only consequences caused by that changed action order may differ after the selected card is played.
factorDefinition.forbiddenDirectEffects: The factor must not alter policy resolution or snapshot, any payoff or combat score, acquisition scoring, target, legal hand, RNG, content, mediator-present cells, below-threshold cells, lethal defence, or an unregistered pair.
factorDefinition.mechanisticallyJustifiedInteractions: Only policyPackageOrder by package-specific payoff eligibility by mediator absence is admitted. Scoreline, Afterimage, Bloodfire and Poison payoff preferences remain separate registered mechanisms and are not pooled into one payoff factor.
factorDefinition.aliasStructure: packageOrder 1 and policyPackageOrder 1 are an invalid aliased configuration and must fail closed. Existing packageOrder 0/1 behaviour is a frozen legacy anchor, not a crossed factor in the next experiment.

anchors.engineTransition: The pre-change exact 4.7.1 replay must equal all frozen 4.7.2 rows before the new source is assessed.
anchors.legacyNullAndUniversal: All 20 existing package-order identity rows must remain exact after removing only policyPackageOrder 0 and the five new observational preference fields.
anchors.controlledHand: Every new surface contains exactly the registered producer, registered consumer and strike against gravewarden at three energy.
anchors.eligibilityBoundary: For each separately registered payoff preference, 0.001 below the median is ineligible and exactly the median is eligible.
anchors.negativeControls: Below-threshold cells and mediator-present cells must retain the exact off choice; all resolved policy, combat-score, eligibility and RNG fields must remain exact within every off/on contrast.
anchors.positiveControls: Every median-eligible, mediator-absent enabled cell must select its registered producer, whose existing content establishes exactly the registered mediator.

estimands.engineIdentity: Canonical equality of all pre-change rows under exact Godot 4.7.1 and the frozen Godot 4.7.2 output.
estimands.legacyIdentity: Canonical equality of current and frozen whole-run, null-surface, universal enabled and mediator-present rows after removing only the preregistered new null and observational fields.
estimands.thresholdBoundary: policyEligible at each separate package preference: false at median minus 0.001 and true at the exact median.
estimands.directMediator: Within each package, preference level and mediator-presence state, policyPackageOrder 1 minus 0 for firstChoice while all other inputs remain fixed.
estimands.directIsolation: Exact equality within every off/on contrast for resolved policy, every normal combat score, preference value, eligibility and RNG before and after choice.
estimands.aliasAndTrustBoundary: policyPackageOrder 2 and packageOrder 1 plus policyPackageOrder 1 must each terminate non-zero before a row is accepted.

successRule: Exact Godot 4.7.1 reproduces the pre-change frozen path; current null and universal behaviour remain exact after the declared observational normalisation; all four preference boundaries, positive controls, below-threshold and mediator-present negative controls, direct-field isolation, invalid level and alias failures pass; and the ledger is byte-identical before and after.
futilityRule: Any exact mismatch, wrong preference key or threshold, unintended direct-field movement, failed positive or negative control, accepted alias or unregistered level, or ledger mutation rejects policyPackageOrder and forbids simulator observations under it.
inconclusiveRule: An immutable-input mismatch, unavailable or checksum-mismatched exact Godot 4.7.1 binary, missing frozen cache object, process failure unrelated to a registered assertion, corrupt cache, timeout or unreadable ledger yields no identity conclusion and no authority for simulator observations.
stoppingRule: Run this fixed preflight once and stop at the first failure. On success, admit only this exact binary eligibility grammar and separately preregister a mechanism-blocked CRN experiment; on futility or inconclusive result, run no simulator row.
